audit_scope: Recomputed summaries and descriptive geometry statistics from saved selected JSONL evaluations; no new model inference or independent reevaluation of every geometry checker. Source/provenance hashes verified where available.

definitions.overall_valid: Structurally valid and every applicable scored check measurably passes.
definitions.all_applicable_pass_fraction: Fraction of outputs with all applicable scored checks passing; does not itself require structural validity.
definitions.all_measurable_pass_fraction: Fraction of outputs with all measurable scored checks passing, ignoring unknowns and not itself requiring structural validity.
definitions.applicable_check_pass_fraction: Passed scored checks / all applicable scored checks, including unknowns.
definitions.compliance: Passed scored checks / measurable scored checks; unknowns excluded.
definitions.severity: Mean normalized severity over measurable scored checks; unknowns excluded.
definitions.compute: Node NFE counts evaluated sample states, excluding edge/reward evaluations. Current control runtime is unmeasured because controls were rebuilt offline. Historical generation and audit times retained separately.

assessment_coverage.statement: 11 scored Appendix A constraints across accessibility, habitability and ventilation; C034/C079/C080 support definitions and are excluded from compliance. Four reporting groups split bedroom and bathroom accessibility. Claims concern potential placements or scenario assumptions, not verified physical installations.
assessment_coverage.submission_requirements: PDF section 2.7: runnable code, machine-readable specs, vector/rendered outputs, report on method/compute/metrics/ablation/results/failures/limitations, comparison table, annotated success/failure evidence.

diversity.interpretation: Semantic distance is 1 minus intersection/union across room-label masks; background and outside are excluded. Near-duplicate fraction counts layouts with at least one close neighbor. All pairs are evaluated.
diversity.limitations: Fixed-canvas low-resolution diagnostics; no translation/rotation/scale alignment. Raster geometry is clipped to the 512-pixel canvas and does not separately encode walls. Eligible counts differ if methods have different structural validity. This is not reference-data fidelity.

distribution_vs_baseline.interpretation: Room counts/areas exclude outside label 6; area is a sum of polygons in drawing-pixel squared units. Wasserstein distances have the original feature units. Composition is pooled over room instances. These marginal diagnostics do not establish perceptual quality or real-data fidelity.
distribution_vs_baseline.comparison_scope: Same scenario, registry, model/checkpoint and representation; SVDD batching differs, so descriptive cross-batch geometry comparison only.
